Libya
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Tripoli, Libya.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Service/Official passport YES
Diplomatic passport YES
Submission of visa applications for the State of Libya is enabled electronically using the services of the main platform Electronic Visa System available at the link: evisa.gov.ly
Citizens of the Libya are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Security conditions: Very complex.
Unsafe areas: Zintan, Ben Walid, Derna, the far south of Libya.
Vaccines: No vaccination required.
Foreign currency: Dollar and Euro are exchanged.
Drugs: Death penalty and life imprisonment are foreseen.
Dialing code: ++218

links.text: the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Tripoli, Libya.
